name: Calling Someone A Fool
overview: Scripture clearly identifies a fool as one who denies God, despises wisdom, and rejects instruction, as seen in Psalms 14:1 and Proverbs 1:7. The fool is characterized by self-righteousness, speaking without understanding, and harboring hidden malice, which leads to corrupt and abominable actions (Proverbs 10:18; 12:15; 18:2; 29:11). In contrast, wisdom is marked by humility, careful speech, and a willingness to receive counsel, highlighting the spiritual danger and folly of a heart that rejects God and divine truth.
